Collecting a <void Void Breach /> makes your next <void Void /> Weapon hit within 10 seconds create a Void Portal.

The Void Portal releases 8 homing Void Orbs at enemies within about 10 meters, each dealing up to <pve 334 /> <pvp [?] /> splash damage in a 3? meter radius.

Damage per Orb, based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: <pve 540 /> <pvp [?] />
• Minibosses and above: <pve 180 /> <pvp [?] />

source.text:
On Void Breach Pickup: 

The next Void Weapon Damage Instance within 10 seconds creates a Void Portal.

Void Portal:
Releases 8 Homing Void Orbs towards enemies within ~10 meters.
Void Orbs deal up to 334 [?] Splash Damage over ~3? meters.
Rank-and-File Combatants take 540 Damage per Orb.
Miniboss+ take 180 Damage per Orb.
